Keywords: Shelter and damaged craft in the Baltic
RagShortTexts: Baltic vessels watched winds, shoals and armed encounters.
Damaged vessels needed landfall and repairs while crews and cargo still needed support.

Baltic coastal vessels watched wind, shallows and possible armed encounters. Crews chose between pursuit, avoidance and landings. Cargo and passenger vessels differed in speed, draught and acceptable risk. Crews, guards and passengers shared space. Armed encounters prompted choices of avoidance or landing; pursuit spent strength and could leave familiar channels.
